$comment: Measured in a real Chromium browser at a 375x812 viewport against the LIVE GitHub Pages URLs. Not a local build, not a static analysis, not an assertion of intent. The harness that produced these numbers is _audit/measure.js and is served alongside the site, so any of this can be reproduced by loading it into the live page and calling window.__auditMeasure().

method.viewport_guard: window.innerWidth confirmed non-zero before any rect was read; a hidden pane reports 0 and makes every layout number a lie
method.page_prepared_by: scrolling the full document height in 700px steps so every IntersectionObserver reveal had fired, then returning to the top and settling for 1.2s
method.tap_target_selector: a[href], button, input:not([type=hidden]), select, textarea, summary, [role="button"], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]) — visible elements only (display, visibility, opacity and a non-zero rect all checked)
method.tap_target_threshold: 44x44 CSS px, failing if EITHER dimension is under 44
method.contrast_threshold: a flat 4.5:1 for every text element, with no large-text exemption claimed
method.contrast_background_resolution: each translucent ancestor layer is alpha-composited down to the first opaque one. Every gradient section on both pages declares a solid background-color underneath its gradients, set to the LIGHTEST point that gradient actually paints, so the measured ratios are conservative — the real ratio on the page is equal or better at every other point of the gradient.
method.gradient_holes: elements carrying a gradient with no solid ancestor to composite against would be reported separately; both pages report none

navigation.$comment: Section anchors carried by the fixed header, and whether each target id exists in index.html. Verified with document.getElementById on the live page.

proof_page_header.$comment: proof.html carries the same six index.html section anchors as cross-page links, plus its own three on-page sections

cold_deep_link.note: this field rendered '$0' before, because it was only ever written from inside a requestAnimationFrame callback; verified separately by stubbing requestAnimationFrame to never fire, after which it still reported the correct figure

known_limits.$comment: Stated plainly rather than left for someone else to find.
items: Contrast is measured against each gradient's declared solid, which is that gradient's lightest painted point. This understates the true ratio elsewhere in the gradient; it never overstates it.

Text sitting on photographic imagery (the creative wall captions and the video tile captions) is measured against the tile's opaque dark placeholder colour, not against per-pixel image content. The captions also carry their own dark scrim gradient.

Tap targets are measured from border-box rects. One inline prose link reaches 44px through padding with a matching negative margin, so its hit box is genuinely 44px tall while the paragraph's line boxes are unchanged.
Measurement covers the 375x812 viewport the bar specifies. Desktop and tablet were reviewed visually but are not enumerated here.
